evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Never asked. Rep jumped directly into logistics probing with 'So just wanna confirm you, yeah, you're moving on Thursday October 29th is that correct?'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns were raised by customer
evidence_quotes.value_days: Rep mentioned Saturday ($230/hr) and Sunday ($210/hr) rates in response to customer's direct question about weekend pricing, but did not proactively offer Value Days as a total dollar saving or ask about date flexibility.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Rep asked 'would you like to go ahead and get on the schedule today?' with no prior mention of rate lock or no-deposit commitment. Customer declined and rep pivoted to email follow-up.

top_strength: Jevic delivered both promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) fully and in recognizable form with clear terms ($50 first hour, $25 half-hour after; $2,000 per move, no deductible, built-in).
coaching_note: The two-concerns question must be asked before any logistics probing begins — it is the primary opener for step 2 and sets the frame for the entire call, but here it was skipped entirely, missing the chance to understand what William actually worried about.
